title: Simplified temperature
description: This datapack is for the Cold Sweat mod, adding the ability to craft insulating armor made of wool.
body:
### Overview
Are you tired of constantly dying during your early game exploration because of extreme temperature mechanics? This datapack is designed to balance the progression of the Cold Sweat mod, making specialized thermal gear more accessible without sacrificing the challenge of survival.

### The Problem
In vanilla Cold Sweat, crafting high-tier temperature-resistant armor often requires materials that are difficult to obtain in the early stages of a playthrough. If you spawn in a freezing Taiga or a scorching Desert, you are often forced to spend hours mining or grinding just to survive the environment. This creates a frustrating barrier to entry rather than an engaging survival experience.

### What This Datapack Changes
This datapack provides a streamlined crafting path for Cold Sweat armor pieces. By rebalancing the recipes, we allow players to craft essential thermal protection gear using more common mid-tier materials.

Balanced Recipes: Craft thermal armor without needing rare end-game loot.

Early Game Viability: Survive harsh biomes immediately after spawning.

Progressive Difficulty: Keep the core survival challenge intact while removing unnecessary frustration.

Compatibility: Works seamlessly with existing Cold Sweat installations and does not conflict with other gear-related mods.

### Why Use This?
Whether you are playing on a multiplayer server with friends or a solo survival world, this datapack ensures that you spend more time exploring and building and less time staring at a "You Died" screen because you were unprepared for the climate. It bridges the gap between early-game vulnerability and mid-game exploration readiness.
